summary: PR #1292 (claude/host-sentinel-inside-loop-vqtl7r) was built in the cloud window on 2026-11-03/04 and fell 400+ commits behind main. It was closed unmerged. Its description: ## Summary - **The sentinel.** While `evolve loop` runs, a goroutine reads the host every `host_sentinel.interval_seconds` (default 180 s). It reads disk free, the Go build cache, the tmux bridge sessions, the finished-cycle orphans and the load per CPU. - **The signals.** Each reading over its threshold emits one `HOST_*` signal with `value` and `threshold`: `HOST_DISK_LOW`, `HOST_CACHE_HIGH`, `HOST_TMUX_HIGH`, `HOST_ORPHANS_HIGH` or `HOST_LOAD_HIGH`. A repeat within the interval does not flood. A failed reading is never read as zero. It gives a `[host] WARN` line and `HOST_SAMPLE_FAILED`, and the loop continues. - **The stages.** At `shadow` (the default) the sentinel only previews: it run
